lines.t: What's in a name the world may say Just breath and sound that fades away
But heaven listens when it's spoken
And chains are loosed and hearts are broken
You call me forward, you call me known
You give me purpose, not my own
Steps unnumbered in your sight
To choose the good, to walk the right
They mocked the name you placed on me
They spoke their lies so bitterly
Yet you have seen, you have heard
Every wound from every word
Those who rise against your truth
Stand on sand, not living proof
When the day you send me comes
Every tongue will know you're one
What's in a name?
The power of God
Written in fire
Sealed by blood
Above all names, none compare
When heaven moves at what's declared
What's in a name, life or death
Mercy spoken with every breath
Blessed are those who trust and stand
Calling on the great I Am
You say my name is not by chance
Not born of flesh or circumstance
It's spoken firm before your throne
A mark that says I'm not alone
They may slander, they may fight
But you will set all things to right
I will go out, I'll come back in
To bring you glory, not for men
The weight of heaven fills the sound
When your holy name resounds
Fear takes hold, hearts are torn
When truth is named, a soul is born
What's in a name?
The power of God
Written in fire, sealed by blood
Above all names, none compare
When heaven moves at what's declared
What's in a name? Hope restored
Salvation in a single word
Blessed are those who trust and stand
Calling on the great I Am
Your name shakes the earth below
Your name makes the strong bend low
One name given, one way true
By which the lost are made brand new
And blessed are those whose names remain
Written where no moth can claim
Everlasting, sealed and sure
Standing firm, they shall endure
Oh, what's in a name? Eternal light
Spoken once, the dark takes flight
Fear gives way, the dead arise
Rise, what's in a name?
All I need, the truth I trust
The life I breathe
Forever held within your flame
I live and stand in your great name
Blessed is the one
Whose name is known
Written in the book of life
Thanks for watching!
